newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse halts trading in four stocks.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse halts trading in four stocks.

text.p: The Thai stock exchange on Thursday halted trading in the shares of Thai Military Bank Plc, Nava Finance and Securities Plc, Thaimex Finance and Securities Plc and CMIC Finance and Securities Plc.

The exchange said trading was halted from the afternoon session because it was awaiting the disclosure of some material information from the companies. It did not detail what information was being awaited.

According to a report issued on Wednesday by Thai Military Bank's unlisted subsidiary Thanapol Finance and Securities Plc, the bank's shareholders had on Tuesday approved plans to merge its finance subsidiaries.
Thaimex Finance and Securities Plc and Nava Finance and Securities Plc are all subsidiaries of Thai Military Bank.
The bank has yet to make such an announcement to the exchange but said in a statement that it would not merge with its subsidiaries.
The bourse than lifted the halt on trading in Thai Military Bank.
CMIC Finance and Securities Plc is a subsidiary of Thai Farmers Bank Plc and the reasons for its halt were also not immediately clear.

A Bank of Thailand meeting this afternoon may be used to announce some form of link between the Nava Finance and Securities Plc, Thaimex Finance and Securities and CMIC Finmance and Securities, brokers said.
